title: It's Not Unusual

oh I wanna' die

It's not unusual, to be mad with anyone

But if I ever find that you've changed at anytime
It's not unusual
To find out I'm in love with you
Whoa oh oh oh oh oh
Whoa oh oh oh
Whoa oh oh oh oh oh
Whoa oh oh oh
